description: Fetch international trade-in-services data (EBOPS 2010 classification). Same bilateral structure as goods trade: returns flow value in USD, period, and reporter/partner/category metadata for each row. Use comtrade_list_service_categories to find the right service code before querying. Note: services trade data has more limited country and period coverage than goods trade.

flow_code.description: Trade flow: M=imports (credit received by reporter), X=exports (debit paid).

partner_code.description: M49 partner code. Use 0 for all partners combined. Omit for a disaggregated by-partner breakdown.

period.description: One or more annual periods (YYYY) or monthly periods (YYYYMM).

reporter_code.description: M49 numeric code of the reporting country.

service_code.description: EBOPS 2010 service category code (e.g. "SA" for transport). Use comtrade_list_service_categories to find available codes. Omit to get totals across all service categories.

name: comtrade_get_services_trade

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Recovery hint when no records are returned.

items.description: A single services trade flow record.

flowCode.description: Trade flow: M=import (credit received), X=export (debit paid).

isReported.description: True if directly reported; false if estimated.

totalCount.description: Total records reported by the API.

truncated.description: True when results were capped at 500 records.

truncationHint.description: How to get full data when truncated.

title: Get Services Trade Data
